dt: All materials, including 3 letters of support, due Jan 1, 2027
e: Annual prize lectureship for a junior scholar in any field of physics: one week in residence at Case Western in spring 2027, giving two technical lectures and a colloquium. Nominees need a PhD awarded between Aug 31, 2018 and Aug 31, 2026 and may not hold a tenured or tenure-track position as of Jan 1, 2027; no citizenship restriction stated.
f: Case Western Reserve University, Department of Physics
n: Case Western Reserve University: Michelson Postdoctoral Prize Lectureship (2027)
unv: A one-week residency award, not a postdoc appointment.
